title: Cheap Helpers, Checked Work
tagline: Cheaper AI does the digging. A second pass checks every source it points to.
what: When a chat needs searching or reading done, it launches helpers: extra AI runs, mostly on cheaper models. A second pass reopens every source they point to before a claim moves on.
built: Every helper gets a model picked for its job from a table, even if the chat forgets to pick
Reports are built only from claims that held up when checked, with nothing new added
Big batches of helpers need a written budget and a size limit, or they don't launch
Helpers get cut off after a set number of steps
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: Me, and the AI chats I run every day

making.problem: A search report needs sources I can trust, without putting every reading job on the most expensive model.

steps.name: Pick the model
steps.says: Each job gets a model from a table I keep: small jobs get the cheap one.

steps.name: Dig
steps.says: Helpers search and read, and note exactly where they found each thing.

steps.name: Check it
steps.says: A separate checker reopens what they pointed to. Only claims that hold up reach me.

moment.what: In my June test, cheap helpers plus a checker got 92% of claims right, versus 45% for the top model alone. A later rerun closed the gap. I kept the source check in the workflow.
